'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an ingredient used in cooking, the primary source of which is the [[Fresh egg basket]]. Once you have acquired the animal farm in the [[Game of Crone]] DLC, eggs can be found in the [[Refugee camp|refugee camp]] storehouse. The GoC Simple Snacks tech unlock also adds the [[Boiled egg|boiled egg]] recipe to the oven. For the main page on preparing food, see [[cooking]].
